/1448;overflow:hidden}
.live-card{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#05070a;container-type:inline-size}
.live-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:fill!important;z-index:5;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.live-portrait{position:absolute;left:var(--portrait-l);top:var(--portrait-t);right:var(--portrait-r);bottom:var(--portrait-b);z-index:1;overflow:hidden;background:#10131a}

.live-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 58%,rgba(0,0,0,.48) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.live-bottom-bg{position:absolute;left:var(--bottom-l);top:var(--bottom-t);right:var(--bottom-r);bottom:var(--bottom-b);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#111319,#08090c);z-index:1}

.live-rank em{font-family:"STKaiti","KaiTi","Kaiti SC","Songti SC",serif;font-size:clamp(7px,2.3cqw,12px);font-style:normal;line-height:1}
.live-nameplate{position:absolute;z-index:8;left:var(--plate-l);top:var(--plate-t);width:var(--plate-w);height:var(--plate-h);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none}
.live-name,.live-title{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;font-family:"STKaiti","KaiTi","Kaiti SC","Songti SC",serif;pointer-events:none}
.live-name>span,.live-title>span{display:block;flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:normal;font-feature-settings:"tnum" 0}
.live-name .v-gap,.live-title .v-gap{height:.36em}
.live-name{font-size:clamp(20px,7.0cqw,31px);gap:.08em;color:#2d2419;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.38);letter-spacing:0;font-weight:500;transform:translateX(2%)}
/* title sits at the upper-left of the nameplate, outside the cream plaque */
.live-title{position:absolute;z-index:9;left:calc(var(--plate-l) - 3.25%);top:calc(var(--plate-t) + 1.6%);font-size:clamp(11px,3.9cqw,18px);gap:.02em;color:#f7f3e8;text-shadow:-1px -1px 0 #16110d,1px -1px 0 #16110d,-1px 1px 0 #16110d,1px 1px 0 #16110d,0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.9)}
.live-signature{position:absolute;left:19%;right:7%;bottom:23.1%;z-index:7;text-align:center;font-family:"STKaiti","KaiTi","Kaiti SC","Songti SC",serif;font-size:clamp(14px,5.2cqw,25px);color:#ffe5a5;letter-spacing:.08em;text-shadow:0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.95)}
.live-skills{position:absolute;z-index:7;left:10.5%;right:8.5%;bottom:5.7%;height:15.2%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(1px,.65cqw,4px);overflow:hidden;color:#e8e0cf;font-size:clamp(7px,2.5cqw,12px);line-height:1.34}
.live-skill{display:block;min-width:0}
.live-skill b{font-family:"STKaiti","KaiTi","Kaiti SC","Songti SC",serif;color:#ffd66e;font-size:1.12em;font-weight:400;margin-right:.25em;white-space:nowrap}
.live-skill span{color:#e8e0cf}
@media(max-width:420px){
 .live-title{left:calc(var(--plate-l) - 3.0%);font-size:clamp(11px,4.15cqw,17px)}
 .live-name{font-size:clamp(20px,7.25cqw,30px)}
 .live-skills{font-size:clamp(7px,2.42cqw,11px)}
}
